topic: User contact data and inventory permissions
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: user contact information management and system development updates.

Regarding contacts, it was discussed whether other users could view or edit a user's full contact details. The current plan is to restrict editing capabilities initially, limiting changes only to fields contained within the task scope (e.g., email field). A local admin role will be implemented later.

In terms of development, [me] noted that the JSON form for contacts was removed/deleted by [p1]. It was confirmed that roles in the 'user' table need updating upon release. [p1] stated they updated this on the sandbox environment. On production, only six users currently have records related to inventory.
decisions: Contact editing will initially be restricted to fields defined within the current task scope.
A local admin role will be implemented later for broader permissions.
action_items: [me] needs to ensure roles in the 'user' table are updated upon release.
